Population increased in Rugby

The estimated population of Rugby in 2024 was 122,378 usual residents, a rise of 2.5% since 2023.

This meant that Rugby's rate of population change placed it among the 10 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Rugby increased by 6.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Rugby was also among the 10% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Rugby

The average (median) age fell to 40.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Rugby has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Rugby is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Rugby's population of 122,378 usual residents was made up of:

  • 24,368 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.9%)
  • 76,260 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.3%)
  • 21,750 people aged 65 years and over, (17.8%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Rugby has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (19.9% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Rugby, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Rugby
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Rugby, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 47 people (0%). In total, there were 1,145 births and 1,098 deaths in Rugby.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 2,168 (1.8%). There were 7,843 people entering the area and 5,675 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Rugby's population of 849 (0.7%) as a result of 1,544 people entering the area and 695 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Rugby was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Rugby in mid-2023 is 119,395.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 372 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 242 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 614 people.
